text_block_list.text:
After leaving the shop and walking in front of the station,
I spotted a large crowd around the street monitor.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Ultimate Favorite Umamusume Showdown"...?
My, they have shows like that on, do they?

text_block_list.name: Popular Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
"‘As expected of Oguri Cap, right?!
Power that brushes off any rival with ease!
Truly overwhelming!!’"

text_block_list.name: Popular Comedian
text_block_list.text:
"The one standing shoulder-to-shoulder with her is Super Creek!
The popularity for the next race is sure to be split right down the middle!!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"They both have an incredible number of fans, after all~!
I hear the popularity of their plushies and other merch is neck-and-neck too!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer... It feels like a dream.To think the day would come when I'd receive this kind of support.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Dashing through alongside you, Trainer,
running with everyone... So much has happened.

For Super Creek, the Arima Kinen marked a major milestone...
What goal should she aim for next...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san. What should I do—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"What gives?! Everyone's just chanting
'Creek and Oguri, Creek and Oguri' in unison!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tama-chan?!
Are you... mad about something, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Course I am! The whole world's talkin' 'bout you guys!
I had a bloody amazing run too, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But honestly, the one I can't forgive the most is YOU!
Did ya catch burnout syndrome or somethin'?
How much of a spineless wimp are ya gonna be?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tama-chan...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Think you've already crossed the finish line?
...The next race has already begun.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "I'm headin' out! See ya later!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tama-chan...!
...Watch out for cars~!
*THUD!*

After watching Tamamo Cross take a spectacular tumble,
I started walking with Super Creek...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, over there... is that Inari-chan?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All right, we've gathered plenty!
Time for Inari One's express courier service to begin!

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Are you really sure you're all right?
Carrying so much luggage all by yourself...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here! This is all part of trainin'!
Heck, it might not even be enough!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"We've" got someone
we wanna show up real good!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...My, Inari-chan too?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Not again.
I'm so hungry, I can't take it...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, Oguri-chan.
You're swaying on your feet so much... Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah... Lately, no matter how much
I eat, I just can't seem to get full.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Train like crazy, then eat; train like crazy, then eat...
I can't escape this endless loop!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Then you really should get some rest~?
If you do, you probably won't even feel hungry♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I know. But my body just moves on its own.
The Arima Kinen I lost flashes in my mind, and it's like an invisible force is pushing me forward...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, talking about it makes me
want to work out again...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Eat, run, eat!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oguri-chan too...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Deep down... I was content.
Thinking how wonderful it would be to just relax with you, Trainer,
and take care of everyone...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“Still, feeling that wall between
myself and everyone else... woke me up.”

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"If my heart drifts away, I wouldn't be able to look after you.
Besides... Trainer and I are—"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I want to move forward even more!
I want to run in races like the Arima Kinen with everyone again!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes... With everyone's support
and Trainer by my side... I won't lose♪
Super Creek smiled. It was the same gentle smile as always...
